maya: Quick sync — proposing an 8-week tile to finish tenant QoS for private pilots. Need owners and showstoppers by EOW.

maya: Goals: p95 <200ms at committed capacity; unit cost delta <=15%; safe canary & rollback path.

aj - eng: +1. I'll own Console rollout gating (W3 demo). Need runtime API for tenant pinning.

vincent - runtime: I'll own runtime spike (prefetch + KV partitioning). Need 2-week spike W1-2 and perf in W3. Blocker: hw for perf.

tess - infra: I can book perf nodes (prefer dedicated). Will do 3 perf days W3. Autoscale scheduler tweak needs 2-3 days to tune.

sara - security: KMS rotation acceptance and audit log format required. Need staging KMS keys from Liam. Integration test by W4.

liam - cs: I'll provide test keys and draft a 1-page launch criteria for W5. Pilot customer requests documented rollback SLA.

cicd-bot: Deployed branch tenant-qos/wip to staging (sha: ab12c3) 1: smoke tests passed.

maya: Deliverables: D1 runtime perf W3 (Vincent), D2 Console gating W3 (AJ), D3 infra perf+autoscale W3-4 (Tess), D4 KMS tests W4 (Sara), D5 migration+runbook W4 (Tess+Vincent+AJ), D6 launch doc W5 (Liam+Maya).

maya: Callouts: Vincent surface perf regression severity levels in report. If anyone can't meet the commitments reply here. I'll post an RFC by EOD. :thumbsup:
